questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 56x^2 + 343 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 49)(x^2 - 7) = 0$ with $49 \neq 7 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{49}, \pm\sqrt{7}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Permutations & Combinations (Dictionary Rank & Grid Paths).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 51x + 50 = 0$ and $x^2 - 9x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (9) + k = 0 \implies k = 8$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Permutations & Combinations (Derangements & Inclusion-Exclusion).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 102x + 4 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{102} = \frac{q}{4} \implies p = 51,\; q = 2 \implies p + q = 53$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Permutations & Combinations (Beggar Method & Multinomial Integral Solutions).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Location of Roots on Real Axis
questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 3$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 6x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 3$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(3) < 0 \implies 3^2 - 2(3^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 9$, so largest integer is $8$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Permutations & Combinations (Circular Permutations with Restrictions).
